sources.label: Growth plan pricing

limitations: A listed PoP and plan inclusion do not demonstrate which edge will serve a particular Korean ISP. No routing measurements were performed.

sources.evidence: Adoption is $299/month with 10 TB. Private CDN Nodes are optional add-ons available on any feature tier with contact-sales pricing. Extra bandwidth commitments depend on regional mix, growth and term. The page does not promise Seoul access with Adoption.

sources.label: CDN Pro pricing and coverage
sources.evidence: The official page lists Seoul and four non-China traffic rates, CPU billing and the Professional minimum. Users select groups by country and ISP. Billing follows the group that serves the request, rather than applying the highest enabled rate to all traffic.

limitations: The public coverage list does not map Seoul to a specific server group. This is a group rate range, not a single Korea rate.
